mentions.name: DocGoblin
mentions.description: A desktop PDF search engine for searching across PDF documents; a bookmark utility is currently being implemented and support for multiple e-book formats is planned.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm still working on my PDF search engine for desktop: https://www.docgoblin.com/
            I'm implementing a bookmark utility right now and hope to add support multiple E-books format in the near future.
